question: Is the round-8 finding 'generated rings are 89.8% three-membered vs 0.43% real' real, or an artefact of real tmQM encoding every metal-ligand bond as DATIVE, which RDKit ring perception does not traverse?
answer: ARTEFACT, IN PART. The gap is real but far smaller than reported.
confound: RDKit ring perception does not traverse DATIVE bonds. Real tmQM writes every metal-ligand bond as DATIVE (->), so the as-written real profile contains ZERO metal-containing rings: the chelate rings that dominate six-metal anticancer chemistry were never counted on the reference side.

like_for_like_arms.note: The generated molecules have no dative bonds (verified), so their ring profile is already fully visible and needs no rewrite. The real corpus does, so the like-for-like real arm is dative->single.

corrected_comparison.how_much_of_the_finding_survives: The 184x becomes roughly 7x on the like-for-like arm. The DIRECTION is unchanged -- generated still over-produces three-membered rings by a large factor and still under-produces 5/6-membered ones -- but the magnitude is a fraction of what was reported, and any PROJECTED SA lift quoted against the 184x figure must be restated.

honest_limitation_survivorship.why: DATIVE->SINGLE followed by sanitisation fails for 70.5% of the corpus (valence / kekulisation). Both arms are computed on the SAME 9183-molecule subset, so the dative effect is not confounded with survivorship -- but the subset is selected (it is the set that tolerates the rewrite) and 70.5% of the corpus is unmeasured in the corrected arm.
honest_limitation_survivorship.not_a_silent_cap: Reported explicitly rather than averaged away. A full-coverage arm would need per-molecule ring perception that tolerates dative bonds, which RDKit does not offer; that is a real gap, not a rounding error.

what_does_NOT_change: Fragmentation was still not the story, and ring SIZE was still the right axis to look at rather than ring count -- both hold on the corrected arm. What changes is the size of the gap, and therefore the size of any lift quoted against it.
supersedes_note: The 0.43% real three-membered figure and the 184x ratio in metrics/by_metric/cfm_opt2_ring_content.json. That file's GENERATED numbers are unaffected (no dative bonds on that side); only its REAL denominator is confounded.
